content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user","i_want":"update an existing task and change its editable fields","so_that":"the task list shows accurate and current task details","business_description":"Users can change an existing task's editable fields (title, description, priority and Due Date) through the task form. Each saved change is validated, stored by the backend, and recorded with a Last Updated Date. The UI reports success or failure only after the backend answers.","business_value":"Tasks stay accurate over time, and users can see when a task was last changed.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"an existing task with a valid title and a Due Date not earlier than its Creation Date","when":"the user opens the edit form, changes the title, and submits the form","then":"the backend stores the new title and the task shows the new title in the list after the backend returns success"},{"given":"an existing task with a valid title, description, priority and Due Date","when":"the user opens the edit form, changes one or more of these fields, and submits the form","then":"the backend stores the changed values and the task shows them in the list after the backend returns success"},{"given":"an existing task being edited in the form","when":"the user clears the title field and submits the form","then":"the backend rejects the update, the task keeps its previous title, and an error message stating that the title is mandatory is shown"},{"given":"an existing task with Creation Date 2024-05-10","when":"the user sets the Due Date to 2024-05-09 and submits the update","then":"the backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored Due Date is unchanged, and an error message is shown"},{"given":"an existing task with a title of 100 characters","when":"the user changes the title to 101 characters and submits the update","then":"the backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored title is unchanged, and an error message stating that the title must be 100 characters or fewer is shown"},{"given":"an existing task with a Last Updated Date and a Creation Date","when":"the user saves a valid change to the task","then":"the backend sets the Last Updated Date to the time of the saved update and the Creation Date is unchanged"},{"given":"a task update request where the backend returns an error","when":"the frontend receives the error response","then":"the frontend does not show the task as updated and displays an error message"},{"given":"a task update request where the backend returns success","when":"the frontend receives the success response","then":"the frontend displays a success message after the update action"},{"given":"a task ID that does not exist in the database","when":"an update request is sent for that ID","then":"the backend returns a Task Not Found error and no data is changed"}],"edge_cases":["The PRD does not say whether the Due Date may be cleared on update; this is an open question and the story does not allow it until it is decided.","The PRD does not say whether status is editable through the update form; status changes are handled only by the status change action in this story.","An update that changes only the description or priority is valid only if the stored Due Date still satisfies the rule that it is not earlier than the Creation Date."],"dependencies":[],"definition_of_done":["Update endpoint validates the title and Due Date and returns the defined errors","Last Updated Date is refreshed on every successful update","Frontend criteria"]},"fixes":[{"finding":1,"revised_tasks":[{"task_key":"BE-task-update-endpoint","task":{"key_slug":"task-update-endpoint","title":"[BE] Add update endpoint for a task by ID with validation It accepts changes to the editable fields (title, description, priority and Due Date), validates the title (non-empty, 100 characters or fewer) and the Due Date (not earlier than the Creation Date), and returns the defined errors for invalid input, missing mandatory fields and Task Not Found. On every successful update, the backend sets the Last Updated Date to the time of the update and leaves the Creation Date unchanged.
